doc.title: Sheila Jordan interviewed by Monk Rowe, Middleburgh, New York, May 11, 2002

title: Rebop, Charlie Parker and his Reboppers
summary: Looking at plaques from Detroit, they discuss the early name rebop and the first record she bought.

story.theme_name: Charlie Parker, Dizzy and the bebop revolution
story.community_name: Charlie Parker: encounters, lore and legacy

blocks.x: I saw some really nice plaques from the City of Detroit on your wall, nice. And it’s curious a couple of them said that at the time the music you were into was called rebop.
Yeah, it started out being rebop.
I guess I had read that but I never —

That was the first record I ever bought was Charlie Parker and his Reboppers. Can I remember the label? Jeez I used to know but I can’t remember now. Yeah, Charlie Parker and his Reboppers. But shortly after that it went to bebop.
